Why do not use batch-size to implement multi-round reset?  like line 424

We know some btree may be very large, for example the byName and byID could have 1M entries.
And we assume some btree should not be too large, for example here the TableInfoResident are those table with special attributes.

Using batch-size we have an extra loop -- we need to visit Descend() *twice at least* to break the for-loop.
So that is not always better than the non-batch-size way.

The first version I wrote is the non-batch way, and copy the code several times.  
Then the batch way, only some of them are updated when I think it's necessary.  @Benjamin2037
